limitations: All finite failed-model metrics and every missing/error endpoint are retained.
Graph OFF/ON contrasts use the same selected build; they do not isolate gains from this code change.
Ingestion and nightly-tier do not evaluate holdout quality or establish gains over historical harness timings.
Numerai uses NumeraiEvaluator(cpu); its historical cache label is unidentified and historical graph ablation had no holdout metric.
Recorded native configs are retained; missing native-config fields are not inferred into measured values.
Nonfinite JSON numbers are represented as NaN/+Infinity/-Infinity strings, retaining their endpoint status.
